source.name: Official Bedrock server: checked tile atlas
source.evidence: BDS 1.26.61.1 build 53069370; exact seed, experiments off. Tiles retain original per-file provenance. Y64: decoded 512 × 512 cells, 1024 native chunk-center checks. Y-48/0/128: decoded 256 × 256 cells, decoder checked against 1156 original and 320 held-out samples. Y103: Cherry Grove native API cells. The route extension contains directly sampled 128 × 128 tiles; research/bds/cherry-route-manifest.json, home-area-manifest.json, west-area-manifest.json north-monument-manifest.json shipwreck-approach-manifest.json and eastern-temple-manifest.json record acquisition evidence and settings for native extensions. Structures: 36 native locator positions, Y unknown, partial coverage. No prediction engine approved. Older Xbox chunks may differ. Source bundle evidence remains in each tile file.
